text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a focused pen-test sprint next week. Goal is to clear the highest-risk vuln buckets and resolve 'evidence debt' before the retest window. Need a quick alignment on RBAC changes, KMS access, and where audit logs are still missing.

alex: +1. Can you spell out the specific RBAC delta we'll need? We should avoid org-wide role changes mid-sprint.

maya: Main asks: (1) temp assessor role with read-only access to staging telemetry, (2) an audit-only service principal for evidence exports, (3) scoped KMS decrypt for assessor-run artifacts.

sam: For the temp role, prefer ephemeral SAML sessions or short-lived tokens. We can script create/delete in the ops playbook. Who owns the cleanup?

jordan: I can own cleanup for product-owned resources. For infra/GCP keys, alex? Also, confirm retention: pen-test exports need 90 days of audit logs, right?

alex: Confirmed 90d. Question about the KMS approach: we should NOT give direct decrypt rights to assessors. Instead we can provision a proxy service that performs decrypts with an audit trail. That keeps KMS ACLs tight.

maya: Agreed — proxy pattern looks safest. Will that block assessor tooling? They need to fetch artifacts and verify evidence.

alex: Not blocking. We can add an endpoint that requires the ephemeral assessor token and logs every request to the audit sink. We already have an internal lambda that can be extended.

sam: On audit logs: current gap is nginx access logs for the staging inference gateway (missing for ~6h last month). We need to capture those during the sprint or mark as evidence debt.

jordan: Can we front the gateway with the load balancer with logging enabled for the window? If it's a config flip, do it during low-traffic hours and notify oncall.

maya: Let's avoid flips during the scheduled user demo on Wed. Proposed plan: enable LB logging Tue 02:00-06:00 PT for a dry run, then full window Thu 22:00-04:00 PT. Sam, can oncall own the maintenance window?

sam: I can run Tue dry run and Thu full window. I'll put a pager rota note and a deploy block if anything spikes.

alex: RBAC change plan: I'll prepare terraform snippets to create the ephemeral assessor role + proxy service account. We'll use `gcloud iam roles create` pattern scoped to the staging project. I'll post snippets in #eng-infra.

jordan: For retest gating: engineering will need a checklist: (a) RBAC in place, (b) KMS proxy active and audited, (c) staging LB logs verified, (d) evidence bucket ACLs read-only for assessor. No retest until all four satisfied.

maya: Good checklist. I'll keep a running tracker. Quick ask: audit-bot, can you snapshot current retention settings and send a proof link?

audit-bot: Audit snapshot: retention=30d for infra logs, 90d for security logs. Missing sources flagged: staging-nginx (6h gap), model-runtime-metrics (12h gap). Proof link: https://internal.audits/redwood/1794042022/snapshot

maya: Thanks. Action items: alex - terraform + proxy PR by Mon EOD; sam - dry run Tue; jordan - confirm evidence bucket ACLs by Wed noon; maya - open vuln triage and label tickets 'evidence-debt' vs 'ready-for-retest'.

alex: Will do. I'll also add an automated test to hit the proxy so assessors can validate decryption path.

sam: One more — incident response note: if assessors trigger a live exploit during testing, follow the pen-test incident flow documented in the runbook and escalate to sec-oncall. I'll update the runbook with the temporary role names.

jordan: I'll block a 30m handoff meeting Fri 09:00 PT to confirm all gates.

maya: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll post the sprint plan + checklist after this thread. :thumbsup:
